caption: The drawing depicts a single doll positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The doll has short, curly blond hair and blue eyes. It is dressed in a black outfit consisting of a long-sleeved top with a laced-up front and a matching skirt that ends above the knees. The top features a white ruffled collar. The doll is shown with its left arm and right leg missing, leaving only the right arm and left leg visible. The skin tones of the doll’s face, hand, and leg are rendered in a pale shade. There are no additional objects or decorations in the composition, and the overall style is simple with minimal shading or background detail.
title: Paper Doll (Boy)
